sport = {}
sport.StepsPercent = 0
sport.StepsCurrent = 0
sport.StepsTarget = 100
sport.ActivityTimePercent = 0
sport.ActivityTimeCurrent = 0
sport.ActivityTimeTarget = 30
sport.StandingTimesPercent = 0
sport.StandingTimesCurrent = 0
sport.StandingTimesTarget = 12


local num_blue = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_BLUE')
local num_green_1 = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_GREEN_1')
local num_green_2 = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_GREEN_2')
local num_red_1 = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_RED_1')
local num_red_2 = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_RED_2')

local function FloatToInt(s)
	local i
	local j
	local q
	local temp
	i = tostring(s)
	print('i:',i)
	j = string.find(i, "%.", 1)
	if j ~=nil and j~=1 then
		temp = string.sub(s,1,j-1)
	else
		temp = i
	end
	print('s:',s)
	print('temp:',temp)
	return tonumber(temp)
end

function multiprogress_timer_callback(arg)
	print('multi progress timer callback')
	arg.StepsCurrent = arg.StepsCurrent + 1
	if(arg.StepsCurrent == (arg.StepsTarget+1)) then
		arg.StepsCurrent = 0
	end
	arg.ActivityTimeCurrent = arg.ActivityTimeCurrent + 1
	if(arg.ActivityTimeCurrent == (sport.ActivityTimeTarget+1)) then
		arg.ActivityTimeCurrent = 0
	end
	arg.StandingTimesCurrent = arg.StandingTimesCurrent + 1
	if(arg.StandingTimesCurrent == (arg.StandingTimesTarget+1)) then
		arg.StandingTimesCurrent = 0
	end
	num_blue:setNumber(arg.StepsCurrent)
	num_green_1:setNumber(arg.ActivityTimeCurrent)
	num_red_1:setNumber(arg.StandingTimesCurrent)

	arg.StepsPercent = FloatToInt(arg.StepsCurrent / arg.StepsTarget * 100)
	arg.ActivityTimePercent = FloatToInt(arg.ActivityTimeCurrent / arg.ActivityTimeTarget * 100)
	arg.StandingTimesPercent = FloatToInt(arg.StandingTimesCurrent / arg.StandingTimesTarget * 100)

   local multiprogress = gui:getComponentByName('MULTI_PROGRESS')
	print("StepsPercent",arg.StepsPercent)
   print("ActivityTimePercent",arg.ActivityTimePercent)
   print("StandingTimesPercent",arg.StandingTimesPercent)
	multiprogress:setFirstPercent(arg.StepsPercent)
	multiprogress:setSecondPercent(arg.ActivityTimePercent)
	multiprogress:setThirdPercent(arg.StandingTimesPercent)
end

local multiprogress = gui:getComponentByName('MULTI_PROGRESS')
multiprogress:setFirstPercent(sport.StepsPercent, false)
multiprogress:setSecondPercent(sport.ActivityTimePercent, false)
multiprogress:setThirdPercent(sport.StandingTimesPercent, false)

num_blue:setNumber(sport.StepsCurrent, false)
num_green_1:setNumber(sport.ActivityTimeCurrent, false)
num_green_2:setNumber(sport.ActivityTimeTarget, false)
num_red_1:setNumber(sport.StandingTimesCurrent, false)
num_red_2:setNumber(sport.StandingTimesTarget, false)

--arg = {}
multiprogress_timer = sys:createTimer(sport, multiprogress_timer_callback, 1000)
multiprogress_timer:run()

print("MULTI_PROGRESS UNLOAD")

multiprogress_timer:stop()
sys:deleteTimer(multiprogress_timer)
multiprogress_timer = nil
--arg = nil
sport = nil

print("progress onload")

time = {}
time.hour = 0
time.min = 0
time.target = 8

local calc_dir = 0
local percent = 0
local progress = gui:getComponentByName('PROGRESS_SLEEP')

local function FloatToInt(s)
	local i
	local j
	local q
	local temp
	local val
	print("s:",s)
	i = tostring(s)
	j = string.find(i, "%.", 1)
	if j ~=nil and j~=1 then
		temp = string.sub(s,1,j-1)
	else
		temp = i
	end
	print("temp:", temp)
	return tonumber(temp)
end

function progress_timer_callback(arg)
	--local progress = gui:getComponentByName('PROGRESS_TEST')
--[[
	if(calc_dir == 0) then
		percent = percent + 5
		if(percent == 100) then
			calc_dir = 1
		end
	else
		percent = percent - 5
		if(percent == 0) then
			calc_dir = 0
		end
	end
--]]
	time.min = time.min + 10
	if(time.min == 60) then
		time.min = 0
		time.hour = time.hour + 1
	end

	local numb_hour = gui:getComponentByName('Sleep_hour')
	local numb_min = gui:getComponentByName('Sleep_min')
	numb_hour:setNumber(time.hour)
	numb_min:setNumber(time.min)
	percent = FloatToInt((time.hour * 60 + time.min) * 100 / (time.target * 60))
	print("percent :", percent)

	if(time.hour == time.target) and (time.min == 0) then
		time.hour = 0
	end

	progress:setProgressPercent(percent)
end

arg = {}
progress_timer = sys:createTimer(arg, progress_timer_callback, 1000)
progress_timer:run()

progress:setProgressPercent(percent, false)

print("progress unload")

progress_timer:stop()
sys:deleteTimer(progress_timer)
progress_timer = nil
--percent = nil
arg = nil
time = nil

	function component_opt_by_id(id, val)
		local ctr_type = gui:getControlType(id)
		local obj = gui:getComponentByName(id)
		if (ctr_type == 'Number') then
			if val then
				obj:setNumber(val)
			else
				return obj:getNumber()
			end
		elseif (ctr_type == 'Text') then
			if val then
				obj:setText(val)
			else
				return obj:getText()
			end
		end
	end

	function fill_call_records(key_id, val_id)
		local key = component_opt_by_id(key_id, nil)
		local val = component_opt_by_id(val_id, nil)
		if (#call_records_table == 5) then
			table.remove(call_records_table, 1)
		end
		call_records_table[#call_records_table + 1] = {key, val}
	end

	function jump_to_call_page(num_id, text_id)
		fill_call_records(num_id, text_id)
		gui:switchPageByName("PAGE_6", "right")
		local phone_out_layout = gui:getComponentByName("PHONE_OUT_LAYOUT", false)
		phone_out_layout:show()

	print('retry scan')
	pg24_needscan = 1
	pg24_titl:showTextByIndex(0)
	pg24_vlist:hide(false)
	if (pg24_btlist_num > 0) then
		pg24_vlist:delGridDynamic(pg24_btlist_num, 1, false)
	end
	pg24_wait:showImageByIndex(0)
	pg24_retry:hide()
	pg24_item = 0
	pg24_btlist_num = 0
	bt:emitterListClean()
	bt:emitterScanStart()
end

local function scan_update(type, arg)
	print('scan_update '..type)
	if (type == "n") then
		local tmp_num = pg24_btlist_num
		pg24_btlist = bt:emitterGetList()
		pg24_btlist_num = #pg24_btlist
		print(">>>>>>>>>>> "..tostring(pg24_btlist_num))
		if (tmp_num ~= pg24_btlist_num) then
			-- update
			if (tmp_num == 0) then 
				pg24_wait:hide(false)
				pg24_vlist:show(false)
			end
			pg24_vlist:addGridDynamic(pg24_btlist_num-tmp_num, 0, true)
		end
	end
end

local function scan_end(type, arg)
	print('scan_end '..type)
	if (type == "hci_event") then
		print('arg '..tostring(arg)..' emu '..tostring(DB.HCI_EVENT_INQUIRY_COMPLETE))
		if (arg == DB.HCI_EVENT_INQUIRY_COMPLETE) then
			print('scan_end! ')
			local tmp_num = pg24_btlist_num
			pg24_btlist = bt:emitterGetList()
			pg24_btlist_num = #pg24_btlist
			-- list update
			if (tmp_num ~= pg24_btlist_num) then
				-- update
				pg24_wait:hide(false)
				pg24_vlist:show(false)
				pg24_vlist:addGridDynamic(pg24_btlist_num-tmp_num, 0, true)
			else 
				if (tmp_num == 0) then
					pg24_wait:hide(true)
				end
			end
			-- scan end
			pg24_titl:showTextByIndex(1)
			pg24_retry:showTextByIndex(0)
		end
	end
end

sys:registerHandler("bt_list", scan_update)
sys:registerHandler("bt_status", scan_end)

if (pg24_needscan == 1) then
	bt:emitterScanStop()
	bt:emitterListClean()

breath_anim = {}
breath_anim.breath_anim_timer = 0
breath_anim.breath_anim_total_time = 0
breath_anim.dir = 0
breath_anim.pic_index = 0
breath_anim.stop_cnt = 0

breath_anim.breath_time = 0
breath_anim.last_breath_time = 0
breath_anim.breath_rhythm = 0
breath_anim.last_breath_rhythm = 0


for k, v in pairs(breath_anim) do
	print(k, v)
end

function breath_anim_refresh(arg)
	--print('breath_anim_refresh')
--[[
	if(breath_anim.breath_anim_timer) then
		breath_anim.breath_anim_timer = 0
	end
--]]
	
	print("breath_anim_total_time : ", breath_anim.breath_anim_total_time)
	if (breath_anim.breath_anim_total_time <= 0) then
		breath_anim.dir = 0
		breath_anim.pic_index = 0
		breath_anim.stop_cnt = 0
		breath_anim.breath_anim_total_time = (breath_anim.breath_time + 1) * 60 * 1000
		gui:switchPageByName('PAGE_60', 'hide')
		return
	end

	breath_anim.breath_anim_total_time = breath_anim.breath_anim_total_time - 128
	--print("stop_cnt : ", breath_anim.stop_cnt)
	if(breath_anim.stop_cnt > 0) then
		breath_anim.stop_cnt = breath_anim.stop_cnt-1
		--breath_anim.breath_anim_timer = sys:createTimer(NULL, breath_anim_refresh, 128);
		return
	end

	--print("pic_index :", breath_anim.pic_index)
	local pic = gui:getComponentByName('BREATH_ANIMATION_PIC')
	pic:showImageByIndex(breath_anim.pic_index)

	if(breath_anim.dir == 1) then
		local text = gui:getComponentByName('BREATH_ANIMATION_TEXT')
		text:showTextByIndex(breath_anim.dir)
		breath_anim.pic_index = breath_anim.pic_index - 1
		if(breath_anim.pic_index == -1) then
			breath_anim.dir = 0
			breath_anim.stop_cnt = 8
			breath_anim.pic_index = breath_anim.pic_index + 1
		end
	else
		local text = gui:getComponentByName('BREATH_ANIMATION_TEXT')
		text:showTextByIndex(breath_anim.dir)
		breath_anim.pic_index = breath_anim.pic_index + 1
		if(breath_anim.pic_index == 31) then

function weather_info_response()
	print("weather_info_response")

	weather = sys:loadWeather()
	--gui:loadWeather()
	local weather_hdl = weather:getWeatherHandle()
	local weather1 = weather:getWeather(weather_hdl)
	local temperature = weather:getTemperature(weather_hdl)
	local humidity = weather:getHumidity(weather_hdl)
	local wind_direction = weather:getWindDirection(weather_hdl)
	local wind_power = weather:getWindPower(weather_hdl)
	local update_time, time = weather:getUpdateTime(weather_hdl)
	local province_len, province = weather:getProvinceData(weather_hdl)
	local city_len, city = weather:getCityData(weather_hdl)

	local pic = gui:getComponentByName('PIC_WAIT_WEATHER_UPDATE')
	if(update_time == 0) then
		pic:show()
	else
		pic:hide()
	end

	--province
	local text_province = gui:getComponentByName('TEXT_PROVINCE')
	text_province:setText(province, true, DB.FONT_ENCODE_UTF8)
	--city
	local text_city = gui:getComponentByName('TEXT_CITY')
	text_city:setText(city, true, DB.FONT_ENCODE_UTF8)
	--weather
	local text_weather = gui:getComponentByName('TEXT_WEATHER')
	local weather_index = {}
	--weather_index['0'] = weather1
	weather_index = {weather1}
	text_weather:showMultiTextByIndex(weather_index, 1)
	--temperature
	local num_temperature = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_TEMPERATURE')
	num_temperature:setNumber(tostring(temperature))	
	--humidity
	local num_humidity = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_HUMIDITY')
	num_humidity:setNumber(humidity)
	--wind_direction
	local text_wind_direction = gui:getComponentByName('TEXT_WIND_DIRECTION')
	text_wind_direction:showTextByIndex(wind_direction)	
	--wind_power
	local num_wind_power = gui:getComponentByName('NUM_WIND_POWER')
	num_wind_power:setNumber(wind_power)
	--update_time
	local update_time = gui:getComponentByName('TIMER_UPDATE_TIME')
	--update_time:setSystemDateTime(time)
	update_time:setUIData(time.year, time.month, time.day)
	update_time:setUITime(time.hour, time.minute, time.second)
end

weather_info_handler = sys:registerHandler("weather_info", weather_info_response)

	local heart_rate_value = 0

	min_time = nil

	cur_time = nil

	heartrate_draw = gui:getComponentByName("BaseForm_999")
end

heartrate_draw_xstep = 8 -- time add 1 hour
heartrate_draw_ystep = 1 -- heartrate add 2

cur_heartrate, cur_time = device:getHeartRate()
start_heartrate, start_time = device:getHeartRate(DB.DEVICE_GET_IND_DATA, 0)

draw_line = {}
next_heartrate, next_time = device:getHeartRate(DB.DEVICE_GET_NEXT_DATA)
draw_line.x1 = start_time * heartrate_draw_xstep + heartrate_draw_rect.x
draw_line.y1 = heartrate_draw_rect.height - start_heartrate + heartrate_draw_rect.y

draw_line.size = 3

for i=0, cur_time - start_time, 1 do

	if not next_heartrate then

	draw_line.y2 = heartrate_draw_rect.height - next_heartrate + heartrate_draw_rect.y

	draw_line.x1 = draw_line.x2
	draw_line.y1 = draw_line.y2
	--print(next_pressure, next_time)
end

if heartrate_draw then
	heartrate_draw:clearDraw(false)
	heartrate_draw = nil
end

if heartrate_draw_rect then
	heartrate_draw_rect = nil
end

end

test_oxygen = {}
test_oxygen.count = 0
test_oxygen.num = 0
test_oxygen.blood_oxygen = device:getBloodOxygen()
test_oxygen.pic = gui:getComponentByName("BaseForm_1016")

function test_oxygen_callback(test)
	local oxygen = device:getBloodOxygen()
	if (test.blood_oxygen ~= oxygen) or (test.num > 10) then
		sys:deleteTimer(test_oxygen.timer)
		test_oxygen.timer = nil
		local blood_oxygen_main = gui:getComponentByName("BLOOD_OXYGEN_MAIN")
		local blood_oxygen_test = gui:getComponentByName("BLOOD_OXYGEN_TEST")
		blood_oxygen_test:hide(false)
		blood_oxygen_main:show()
	else
		if test.count == 0 then
			test.count = 1
		else
			test.count = 0
		end
		test.pic:showImageByIndex(test.count)
	end
	test.num = test.num + 1
end

test_oxygen.timer = sys:createTimer(test_oxygen, test_oxygen_callback, 500)
test_oxygen.timer:run()

if test_oxygen then
	if (test_oxygen.timer) then
		sys:deleteTimer(test_oxygen.timer)
		test_oxygen.timer = nil
	end
	test_oxygen = nil
end

function wait_test_blood_oxygen(arg)

		start_lay = gui:getComponentByName("BLOOD_OXYGEN_START")
		test_lay = gui:getComponentByName("BLOOD_OXYGEN_TEST")
		start_lay:hide(false)
		test_lay:show()

	elseif arg.count < 4 then
		wait_test.number:setNumber(arg.count)
		if (wait_test.number:isHide()) then
			wait_test.number:show()
		end
	end
end

	timetable["second"]=timecnt%60
	timetable["minute"]=(timecnt-(timecnt//3600)*3600)//60

	timepage1:setSystemTime(timetable,1,0)
	timepage2:setSystemTime(timetable,1,0)
	timepage3:setSystemTime(timetable,1,0)
print("J")
end

luascript.code:
setupHandler = sys:getSetupHandler()
day_undisturb_sel = setupHandler:syncSetupParam(DB.AllDayUndisturbEn, 0, true)
pic_day_undisturb = gui:getComponentByName("PIC_UNDISTURB_ALL_DAY")
pic_day_undisturb:showImageByIndex(day_undisturb_sel, false)

setupHandler = nil
pic_day_undisturb = nil
hide_layout = nil
show_layout = nil

all_day_undisturb_ontouch = 1
day_undisturb_sel = setupHandler:syncSetupParam(DB.AllDayUndisturbEn, 0, true)
if (day_undisturb_sel == 1) then
	day_undisturb_sel = 0
else
	day_undisturb_sel = 1
end

if (day_undisturb_sel == 1) then
	pic_day_undisturb:showImageByIndex(day_undisturb_sel, false)
	hide_layout = gui:getComponentByName("LAYOUT_UNDISTURB_MODE")
	hide_layout:hide()

	show_layout = gui:getComponentByName("LAYOUT_TIPS_UNDISTURB_MODE")
	show_layout:show()
else
	pic_day_undisturb:showImageByIndex(day_undisturb_sel, true)
end

setupHandler:syncSetupParam(DB.AllDayUndisturbEn, day_undisturb_sel, false)
